name: rf-quadrupole-confined
description: Closed form: sqrt(kT / (m omega_sec^2)) with omega_sec from the COLLISIONAL pseudopotential, written entirely from the document's own declared quantities - charge, mass, amplitude, inscribed radius, drive frequency, mobility and temperature. Nothing is read back from the engine. Measured at 1.2e-6 of it. The one per cent tolerance is room for a change of grid or step scheme, not a modelling allowance: what it cannot absorb is the collisionless well, which is ten per cent away, or the missing factor of two in the field amplitude, which is a factor of four.
